title: Photography: Out of Auto
subtitle: A field workbook
summary: Written for one camera and one habit: a superzoom with a 2000 mm lens, left on its bird mode because the dials are confusing. Each setting the camera was choosing is handed back to you in turn, and the figures re-expose real photographs as you change it. By the end you should be able to stand in a marsh at dusk and pick the shutter speed yourself.
